title: Seen but Unsaid: Locating and Repairing Cross-Image Comparison in Vision-Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2611.21539v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) often fail to match a point or an object across two images, even when the answer can be decoded from their own hidden states. We trace this failure from the visual tokens to the answer letter, in Qwen3-VL (2B-32B), InternVL3.5-8B, and Gemma-3-12B, on synthetic shape matching, same-instance point correspondence (HPatches), and semantic correspondence (SPair-71k), and find two distinct failure points, a small set of attention heads that carries the comparison, and a repair that touches 0.02% of the parameters. Two failure points: exact copies are compared but not read out. An answer-position probe exceeds the calibrated output by 15 to 25 points in every family, for nameable and unnameable shapes alike, and steering along the probe's direction moves no more answers than random directions. Semantic correspondences are present in the visual tokens but never reach the answer. One pathway: redistributing the cro

translated_title: 看见却未言说：定位与修复视觉-语言模型中的跨图像比较
translated_abstract: 视觉-语言模型（VLMs）在跨两张图像匹配一个点或一个物体时常常失败，即使答案可以从它们自身的隐藏状态中解码出来。我们在Qwen3-VL（2B-32B）、InternVL3.5-8B和Gemma-3-12B上，针对合成形状匹配、同实例点对应（HPatches）和语义对应（SPair-71k）任务，从视觉token追踪到答案字母，发现了两个不同的失败点、一小部分承载比较功能的注意力头，以及一个仅涉及0.02%参数的修复方法。两个失败点：精确副本被比较但未被读取出来——在所有模型家族中，答案位置探针都比校准后的输出高出15到25个百分点，无论形状是否可命名都是如此，且沿探针方向引导所带来的答案变化不比随机方向多；语义对应存在于视觉token中但从未到达答案。一条通路：重新分配cro…（摘要截断）
tldr: 该论文发现视觉-语言模型在跨图像比较任务上的失败是因为比较信息存在于视觉token和隐藏状态中却未传递到最终答案，通过定位一小部分承载比较功能的注意力头，提出了仅修改0.02%参数的修复方法。
en_tdlr: This paper traces why vision-language models fail at cross-image comparison—comparison information exists in visual tokens but never reaches the answer—locates a small set of attention heads that carry the comparison, and proposes a repair that touches only 0.02% of the parameters.
